label: The Lodge on Cutter Ridge
summary: Six strangers wait out a blizzard in an empty ski lodge above Hollow Pines. Every night, one of them sleepwalks to the same locked door.
title: The Lodge on Cutter Ridge
description: The lodge closed years ago, but the blizzard leaves six travelers no choice. The fireplace still works. The guest book still has entries, and the newest one is dated tomorrow.

chapterOutlines.title: Snowbound
chapterOutlines.outline: Get everyone inside, find the guest book, and notice the door no key fits.

chapterOutlines.title: Night Walkers
chapterOutlines.outline: Watch the sleepwalkers, and learn what each traveler is running from.

chapterOutlines.title: The Locked Door
chapterOutlines.outline: Open the door before the storm ends, or keep it shut for good.

scene.location: The great room of the abandoned Cutter Ridge lodge
scene.summary: Dusk, and the snow is already up to the windows. Someone has got the fire going. Five tired faces look at you as if you know what to do.

openThreads: What is behind the locked door?
Who wrote tomorrow’s entry in the guest book?

npcs.name: June Halloran
npcs.description: Knows the ridge better than anyone and swore she would never come back up here.
goals: Get everyone down the mountain alive

npcs.name: Felix Marr
npcs.description: Cheerful, talkative and carrying a suitcase he never lets out of his sight.
goals: Get to the city before anyone opens the suitcase
abilities: Can talk his way into or out of almost anything
